Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_ID VARCHAR2(14);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date is null
 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_ID := '';
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 
 if :component_sp.unit_id is not null then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from component_spiking
 where unit_id = :component_sp.unit_id 
 and chapter_id = :component_sp.chapter_id
 and coll_date = :component_sp.coll_date 
 and process_code = :component_sp.process_code;
 if temp_count <= 0 then
 message('Msg: Unit does not have spiked bags');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 -- :GLOBAL.field_left1 := :system.cursor_field;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('component_spiking');
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end ;
 else
 show_error('1180');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
end;
